name: dsfd_vm_xio_return_native_1016_r3

pin_regs.reason: Actual source first-stage input return captures, issue/output pin registers; component exact fixed-edge differential gate plus six observed mutants.

structural_change: r3 (S-VM-XRET 10-16): (1) RTL: e_v / return_valid / f_xgo get plain pin capture flops (ev_raw / valid_raw / xq_raw <= pin); the rn qualification is applied after the flop from a registered rn copy (rq[2]): rn_d ? raw : 0 equals the former rn ? pin : 0 captured at the same edge -- zero cycle change, proved by tools/s81_vm/xio_return_r3_equiv_gate.sh (r3 vs frozen r2, every output every cycle, random inputs through 400 async resets x 4 seeds; mutant RNQ fails). r2 mapped ev_pin<=rn?e_v:0 to AND2 + SDFF; io_flop_at_pins walks INV/BUF only, so the four e_v flops were never anchored and sat at x=162-164 um, 162 um from their W pins (BUFx16f wire buffer + BUFx2): e_v[0] TT setup -47.3 ps + R 267.3 = capture 220.0 > 190. (2) Outline right-sized by pin perimeter 216x324 -> 54x324 with 3-track pin spacing (synth util 0.12 at 75.6x280.8 in the first gate; r3 synth 2368 um2 -> 0.15, ~0.25-0.3 after repair). Static fixed-cycle; no backpressure, no clock relaxation.

arithmetic.W_dim: synthesized std area 2368 um2 (gate on 992cc9cb4), r2 final 4529 um2 incl. 162 um wire buffering; W = 54 (5 x 10.8): core 49.68 x 319.68 = 15,882 um2 -> util 0.15 synth .. 0.29 at the r2 final area; die 17,496 um2 = 0.25x r2's 69,984
